system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Managed Instance Group with autoscaling (min 1, max 5) behind an HTTPS Load Balancer.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Managed Instance Group with autoscaling (min 1, max 5) behind an HTTPS Load Balancer.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: instance-template.jinja

resources:
- name: mig-instance-template
  type: instance-template.jinja
  properties:
    machineType: e2-medium
    disks:
    - deviceName: boot
      type: PERSISTENT
      boot: true
      autoDelete: true
      initializeParams:
        sourceImage: projects/debian-cloud/global/images/family/debian-11
    networkInterfaces:
    - network: global/networks/default
      accessConfigs:
      - name: External NAT
        type: ONE_TO_ONE_NAT
    tags:
      items:
      - http-server
      - https-server
    metadata:
      items:
      - key: startup-script
        value: |
          #!/bin/bash
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y nginx
          echo "Hello from $(hostname)" > /var/www/html/index.html
    serviceAccount:
      email: default
      scopes:
      - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform

- name: mig-health-check
  type: compute.v1.healthCheck
  properties:
    type: HTTP
    httpHealthCheck:
      port: 80
      requestPath: /
    checkIntervalSec: 5
    timeoutSec: 5
    healthyThreshold: 2
    unhealthyThreshold: 3

- name: mig-backend-service
  type: compute.v1.regionBackendService
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    backends:
    - group: $(ref.mig-instance-group.selfLink)
    healthChecks:
    - $(ref.mig-health-check.selfLink)
    protocol: HTTP
    loadBalancingScheme: EXTERNAL_MANAGED
    sessionAffinity: NONE
    timeoutSec: 30

- name: mig-url-map
  type: compute.v1.urlMap
  properties:
    defaultService: $(ref.mig-backend-service.selfLink)

- name: mig-ssl-certificate
  type: compute.v1.sslCertificate
  properties:
    managed:
      domains:
      - example.com

- name: mig-target-https-proxy
  type: compute.v1.targetHttpsProxy
  properties:
    urlMap: $(ref.mig-url-map.selfLink)
    sslCertificates:
    - $(ref.mig-ssl-certificate.selfLink)

- name: mig-forwarding-rule
  type: compute.v1.forwardingRule
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    IPAddress: 
    IPProtocol: TCP
    portRange: 443
    target: $(ref.mig-target-https-proxy.selfLink)
    loadBalancingScheme: EXTERNAL_MANAGED

- name: mig-instance-group
  type: compute.v1.regionInstanceGroupManager
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    instanceTemplate: $(ref.mig-instance-template.selfLink)
    targetSize: 1
    baseInstanceName: mig-instance
    namedPorts:
    - name: http
      port: 80
    autoHealingPolicies:
    - healthCheck: $(ref.mig-health-check.selfLink)
      initialDelaySec: 300
    updatePolicy:
      type: PROACTIVE
      minimalAction: REPLACE
      maxSurge:
        fixed: 1
      maxUnavailable:
        fixed: 1
      replacementMethod: SUBSTITUTE
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - mig-instance-template

- name: mig-autoscaler
  type: compute.v1.regionAutoscaler
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    target: $(ref.mig-instance-group.selfLink)
    autoscalingPolicy:
      minNumReplicas: 1
      maxNumReplicas: 5
      cpuUtilization:
        utilizationTarget: 0.6
      coolDownPeriodSec: 60
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - mig-instance-group
